scope: Read-only review; no GPU, network, Git, or source mutation. VERIFIED states its verification level in method; raw-unavailable claims are separately UNVERIFIABLE.

results.claim: K1 corrected GT-mask distance: 75.05 deployed, 91.99 GT; Pi3X 73.38, DA3 71.02
results.method: Recompute strict-threshold MRA from predictions and corrected labels; use every GT row, missing/refusals zero, then item-weighted mean. No stored MRA used.

results.claim: About 17 type points of geometry gap
results.method: Subtract recomputed corrected held-out means. This contrast changes geometry; it does not isolate the single-view loss.

results.claim: Presence 32.9 vs 71.3; GT-presence counting 24.8
results.method: Reaggregate per-item scores by type. Appearance: 47/143 vs 102/143. GT-presence 24.8 belongs to counting, not appearance.

results.claim: Stored-label 60.4 predicted masks vs 68.0 GT masks
results.method: Verify source-summary values and their denominators; this is not a paired instance-choice effect. Predicted uses 214 answered rows; GT uses 216.

results.claim: K1 camera DA3 1.78 vs G3T 2.72 degrees
results.method: Read exact saved pair medians and independently aggregate capture-level turn/move scores. Pair-level rotation arrays are not in this summary; pair medians are source-summary verification only.

results.claim: Fragment bucket arithmetic: fewer than 3 frames 55.4 vs 73.9; 142 gaps 61.8
results.method: Weighted means from cited rounded buckets only; independent per-item verification remains UNVERIFIABLE below.

results.claim: Camera loss shares 55% and 52%
results.method: Recompute shares from rounded counts and means; this verifies arithmetic only, not the absent camera predictions or a causal noise floor.

results.claim: Projected totals arithmetic
results.method: Arithmetic only. Totals assume independent incremental gains, which the kits do not measure.

results.method: Subtract cited table cells; source-summary verification, not raw replay. Statistical tie for relative distance does not mean exact equality.
